resolved_findings.finding: Initial parent releases hashed child inventories without actual released material. Intermediate assembly intake omitted emitted downstream coupons.
resolved_findings.resolution: Explicit target-bound release manifests now preserve exact incoming coupon/device identities through RECEIPT, ASSEMBLE and downstream routes. resolved_findings.resolution: Actor event IDs include the episode digest; observations and raw records carry episode_id; cross-episode replay is rejected.

resolved_findings.resolution: Rear-flux acquisition now follows configuration, current interlocks and light acquisition and binds the current active exposure.
